<Heading

  children={"Get block(s) by hash or number."}
>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/blocks/{block_ref}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



If a hash is passed, returns the matching block. If a number is given, gives the blocks by that number - could be pruned and/or finalized.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>
